name: UI/UX Pro Max Design Intelligence Database

entries.title: Kitchen Operations & Inventory Utility
entries.description: Optimized for fast-paced commercial kitchens and restaurant managers. Prioritizes instant scannability, high visual contrast under varied lighting, bold metric anchors, and touch-friendly controls.

tokens.card: bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl shadow-sm

rules: Keep KPI metrics large and bold (text-2xl or text-3xl font-semibold).
Use colored status pills with muted backgrounds (e.g. bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700) rather than harsh saturated fills.
Ensure stockout or expiry warning alerts stand out immediately using high-contrast borders or warning banners.

entries.title: Bento Grid Dashboard Architecture
entries.description: Modular layout organizing complex data into distinct functional cells with varying column and row spans. Creates clear visual rhythm without visual clutter.

tokens.cell: rounded-2xl p-5 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md

rules: Span primary actionable cards (like inventory summary or today's prep) across 2 columns.
Keep peripheral quick stats or sensor status in compact 1-column cards.
Maintain consistent padding and radius across all bento cards.

entries.title: Fresh Produce & Kitchen Inventory Palette
entries.description: Balanced color system reflecting fresh ingredients, kitchen hygiene, and operational safety.

entries.title: High-Legibility Numerical & Data Table Typography
entries.description: Font pairing for inventory tables, ledger sheets, and real-time weight meters.

guidelines.data_numbers: tabular-nums font-mono (or font-sans with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums)

entries.title: React 18 + Tailwind CSS Guidelines
entries.description: Standard coding conventions for component structure, styling, and accessible state management in React + Tailwind.
rules: Encapsulate recurring design tokens in shared UI components (e.g. Button, Badge, Card, Modal in src/ui.tsx).
Avoid arbitrary inline styles (style={{ ... }}); use standard Tailwind utility classes.
Always pair hover states with active and focus-visible states: e.g. 'hover:bg-slate-100 active:bg-slate-200 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500 focus-visible:outline-none'.
Ensure all interactive icons include an accessible label: '<button aria-label="Refresh readings"><Icon /></button>'.

entries.title: Recharts & IoT Live Data Visualizations
entries.description: Best practices for real-time sensor streams and demand forecasting charts in Recharts.
rules: Format tooltips cleanly using custom Tooltip renderers with formatted date and unit labels (e.g. '24.5 kg').
Color code confidence intervals with soft fills (e.g. fill="#10b981" fillOpacity={0.15}).
Provide accessible text alternatives or data table fallbacks for visually impaired users.
